# Cloudinary MCP connector

Upload images and videos to Cloudinary and get a public URL, search and organize your media library, generate AI images and build transformations from Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot through Cloudinary's official MCP server. The AnythingMCP connector gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini 30 MCP tools for Cloudinary: 13 read and 17 can change data.

[![Open Cloudinary in AnythingMCP Cloud](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open%20in-AnythingMCP%20Cloud-1f6feb?style=for-the-badge)](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/login?mode=register&redirect=%2Fconnectors%2Fstore%3Finstall%3Dcloudinary&utm_source=github&utm_medium=catalog&utm_campaign=cloudinary)

**Category:** [File Storage](../storage.md) · **Tools:** 30 · **Setup guide:** [anythingmcp.com](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/cloudinary-to-mcp) · [Deutsch](https://anythingmcp.com/de/guides/cloudinary-to-mcp) · [Italiano](https://anythingmcp.com/it/guides/cloudinary-to-mcp) · [Español](https://anythingmcp.com/es/guides/cloudinary-to-mcp) · [日本語](https://anythingmcp.com/ja/guides/cloudinary-to-mcp) · [Русский](https://anythingmcp.com/ru/guides/cloudinary-to-mcp) · [中文](https://anythingmcp.com/zh/guides/cloudinary-to-mcp)

## Start without code

No installation and no terminal: AnythingMCP Cloud runs the Cloudinary connector for you, operated by helpcode.ai in Frankfurt, Germany.

1. **Click the button above** and create an account or sign in. The Cloudinary connector opens, ready to install.
2. **Sign in with your Cloudinary account** when AnythingMCP asks. The first time, an admin creates a small app in the Cloudinary developer console. Every click is in the [step-by-step guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/cloudinary-to-mcp).
3. **Click Install.** AnythingMCP shows the address of your MCP server.
4. **Add that address to your assistant:** [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-cloudinary-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-cloudinary-to-chatgpt) · [Microsoft Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-cloudinary-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-cloudinary-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-cloudinary-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-cloudinary-to-muse).
5. **Ask your first question**, for example: *Find the image asset for invoice INV-2026-042 for customer Nordic Solar OÜ, give its secure URL and upload date.*

Prefer help with the setup? [Talk to us](https://anythingmcp.com/contact).

## How it works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  client["Claude · ChatGPT · Copilot · Cursor"]
  amcp["AnythingMCP<br/>roles · audit log · encrypted credentials"]
  api["Cloudinary API<br/>asset-management.mcp.cloudinary.com"]
  client -- "MCP, OAuth or API key" --> amcp
  amcp -- "HTTPS, an OAuth 2.0 access token, refreshed automatically" --> api
```

- **The AI client** speaks MCP (Streamable HTTP) to AnythingMCP and only sees tool names, descriptions and results. It never gets the Cloudinary credentials.
- **AnythingMCP** checks the client's role, builds the call from the tool definition, adds the credentials (an OAuth 2.0 access token, refreshed automatically), calls Cloudinary, logs the call and returns the result.
- **Cloudinary** sees an ordinary API client with the rights of the account the credentials belong to.

## Tool reference

Every parameter as the AI client sees it in `tools/list`. Source: [`packages/backend/src/adapters/intl/cloudinary.json`](../../../packages/backend/src/adapters/intl/cloudinary.json).

### `cloudinary_upload_asset`

Upload an image, video or other file to Cloudinary from a public HTTP(S) URL, a Base64 data URI, an FTP address or a private S3 or Google Cloud Storage bucket, and get back its permanent public delivery URL (`secure_url`). This is the way to turn a generated or attached file into a public link that Instagram, Facebook or another API can fetch.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `upload-asset /mcp`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resource_type` | `image` \| `video` \| `raw` \| `auto` | no | The type of resource (image, video, raw, or auto). |
| `upload_request` | object | yes | The file to upload and associated parameters. |

### `cloudinary_asset_rename`

Rename an asset by changing its public ID (and optionally its delivery type). The delivery URL changes with it, so links already shared stop working.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `asset-rename /mcp`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resource_type` | `image` \| `video` \| `raw` | yes | The type of resource (image, video, or raw). |
| `RequestBody` | object | yes | The rename request parameters. |

### `cloudinary_generate_archive`

Create a ZIP or TGZ archive of selected assets (by public IDs, tags or prefix) and return the archive's download URL.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `generate-archive /mcp`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resource_type` | `image` \| `video` \| `raw` \| `all` | yes | The type of resource for archive generation (image, video, or raw). |
| `RequestBody` | object | yes | The archive generation parameters. |

### `cloudinary_download_asset_backup`

Download a backed-up version of an asset by its asset ID and version ID. Needs backups switched on for the product environment.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `download-asset-backup /mcp`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `asset_id` | string | yes | The asset ID of the resource. Must be a 32-character hexadecimal string. |
| `version_id` | string | yes | The version ID of the backup to download. Must be a 32-character hexadecimal string. |

### `cloudinary_delete_asset`

Delete an asset permanently by its asset ID, optionally invalidating the CDN cache. Installed switched off; turn it on per tool if the AI may delete.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `delete-asset /mcp`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `request` | object | yes | The asset to delete and related options. |

### `cloudinary_list_images`

List image assets, filtered by delivery type, public ID prefix, public IDs or tag, newest or oldest first, with cursor pagination (`next_cursor`).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `list-images /mcp`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | any | no | The delivery type to filter by. When omitted, returns assets of all delivery types. |
| `prefix` | string | no | A public_id prefix. When specified, all assets with that prefix are returned. |
| `public_ids` | string[] | no | An array of public IDs to return. |
| `tags` | boolean | no | Whether to include the list of tag names assigned to each asset. Default is false. |
| `next_cursor` | string | no | Cursor for pagination. |
| `max_results` | integer | no | Maximum number of results to return (1-500). |
| `direction` | `asc` \| `desc` | no | The sort direction for the results. Default is "desc". |
| `start_at` | string | no | An ISO-8601 formatted timestamp. When specified, returns resources created since that timestamp. Supported only if neither `prefix` nor `public_ids` were passed. |
| `fields` | any | no | Additional fields to include in the response. The fields public_id and asset_id are always included. |

| `fields` | any | no | Additional fields to include in the response. The fields public_id and asset_id are always included. |

### `cloudinary_get_asset_details`

Get one asset by its asset ID: public ID, delivery URLs, format, size, dimensions, tags and metadata, plus on request colors, faces, quality and accessibility analysis, versions and derived assets.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `get-asset-details /mcp`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `asset_id` | string | yes | The asset ID of the resource. Must be a 32-character hexadecimal string. |
| `colors` | boolean | no | Whether to include color information (predominant colors and histogram of 32 leading colors). Default: false. |
| `media_metadata` | boolean | no | Whether to include IPTC, XMP, and detailed Exif metadata in the response. Default: false. |
| `faces` | boolean | no | Whether to include a list of coordinates of detected faces. Default: false. |
| `quality_analysis` | boolean | no | Whether to return quality analysis scores for the image. Default: false. |
| `accessibility_analysis` | boolean | no | Whether to return accessibility analysis scores for the image. Default: false. |
| `pages` | boolean | no | Whether to report the number of pages in multi-page documents (e.g., PDF). Default: false. |
| `phash` | boolean | no | Whether to include the perceptual hash (pHash) of the uploaded photo for image similarity detection. Default: false. |
| `coordinates` | boolean | no | Whether to include previously specified custom cropping coordinates and faces coordinates. Default: false. |
| `versions` | boolean | no | Whether to include details of all the backed up versions of the asset. Default: false. |
| `max_results` | integer | no | Maximum number of derived assets to return. Default: 10. |
| `derived_next_cursor` | string | no | The cursor for the next page of derived assets when there are more derived images than max_results. |

### `cloudinary_search_folders`

Search asset folders by name, path or creation date with a Lucene-like expression; returns up to 2,000 folders.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `search-folders /mcp`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expression` | string | no | The (Lucene-like) string expression specifying the search query. If not passed, returns all folders (up to max_results). |
| `sort_by` | object[] | no | Sort order for the results. Each item maps a field name to a direction. |
| `max_results` | integer | no | Maximum number of folders to return (max 500, default 50). |
| `next_cursor` | string | no | The cursor for pagination. Use the next_cursor value from a previous response to get the next page of results. |

### `cloudinary_search_assets`

Search assets with Cloudinary's Lucene-like expression language (tags, folder, format, size, dimensions, dates, structured and contextual metadata and more), with sorting, aggregations, selected fields and cursor pagination.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `search-assets /mcp`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `request` | object | yes | The search query parameters. |

### `cloudinary_generate_image`

Generate an image from a text prompt with Cloudinary's Image Generation add-on and store it in the product environment, so it has a public delivery URL. It waits for the image by default; with `async: true` it returns at once and `cloudinary_get_generation_task` reports the result.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `generate-image /mcp`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `request` | object | yes | A JSON object containing the generation request parameters. |

### `cloudinary_generate_image_from_images`

Generate an image guided by one or more reference images (stored assets or HTTPS URLs) and a prompt: restyle, on-brand variants, consistent characters, edits and extensions. With `async: true` it returns at once and `cloudinary_get_generation_task` reports the result.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `generate-image-from-images /mcp`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `request` | object | yes | A JSON object containing the image-to-image generation request parameters. |

### `cloudinary_get_generation_task`

Get the status and, once finished, the result of an image generation task started with `cloudinary_generate_image` or `cloudinary_generate_image_from_images`.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `get-generation-task /mcp`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task_id` | string | yes | The ID of the generation task. |

### `cloudinary_get_tx_reference`

Return Cloudinary's transformation reference: the parameters and syntax rules for transformation strings and transformed delivery URLs. Read it once per session before building a transformation.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `get-tx-reference /mcp`

No parameters.

### `cloudinary_transform_asset`

Create derived versions of an existing asset with a transformation string (for example `c_fill,w_1080,h_1080/f_auto/q_auto`) through the explicit API and return their URLs.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `transform-asset /mcp`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `publicId` | string | yes | The public ID of the existing asset to transform |
| `transformations` | string | yes | VALIDATED transformation string using ONLY parameters from get-tx-reference docs. Examples: 'c_fill,w_300,h_200' or 'e_sepia/a_90'. MUST follow component rules: commas within components, slashes between components. |
| `resourceType` | `image` \| `video` \| `raw` | no | The resource type of the asset |
| `invalidate` | boolean | no | Whether to invalidate cached versions |

### `cloudinary_sign_upload`

Sign Upload API parameters so a file on the user's own machine can be posted straight to Cloudinary. Returns the signed parameters, signature, API key, host and cloud name; the file itself is posted by the caller, not by AnythingMCP.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `sign-upload /mcp`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uploads` | object[] | yes | One or more sets of Cloudinary Upload API parameters to sign. Returns one signed credential object per entry, in the same order. Only genuine Upload API params are signed; file, resource_type, api_key, and signature are excluded. |

## Run it yourself

AnythingMCP is open source (AGPL-3.0). [Run it with Docker](../../../README.md#run-it-yourself), open **Connectors → Store**, pick **Cloudinary**, then add your MCP server URL to the AI client.
